abstract: This article proposes the Strategic Delegitimization and Selective Amplification (SDSA) model to reconceptualize accusations of 'fake news' as rhetorical weapons in political conflict rather than merely as instances of misinformation. Focusing on Italian newspapers, the authors examine how political actors deploy fake news accusations strategically and how media outlets selectively amplify these claims. The framework repositions fake news discourse within the study of negative campaigning and political communication.
key_claims: Fake news accusations function as strategic communicative practices, not just responses to misinformation.
Political actors weaponize accusations of fake news for delegitimization purposes in negative campaigning.
Media outlets selectively amplify certain fake news accusations, shaping their political impact.
A dedicated theoretical model (SDSA) is needed to capture the rhetorical and strategic dimensions of fake news discourse.
methods: Development of a novel theoretical framework (the Strategic Delegitimization and Selective Amplification model).
Empirical focus on Italian newspapers as sites where fake news accusations are amplified (further methodological detail not available from the abstract).
findings: Specific empirical findings are not stated in the available abstract.
contributions: Introduces the SDSA model as a new conceptual tool for analyzing fake news accusations.
Reframes fake news scholarship from a misinformation problem to a strategic rhetorical practice.
Connects the study of fake news to literatures on negative campaigning and political delegitimization.
Provides an Italian case-based lens for understanding media amplification of political accusations.
framing: The paper positions itself against dominant approaches that treat fake news as a misinformation problem, aligning instead with research on negative campaigning, political rhetoric, and strategic communication. It contributes to political communication scholarship by theorizing accusations of fake news as tools of delegitimization amplified through partisan media ecosystems.
